title: Bridge handshake
description: GET /api/health. The first call any client makes. A 200 on a fixed loopback port is not proof you reached OAIY — an unrelated app has already answered this shape on a neighbouring port — so `product` must be matched exactly.

product.description: Stable machine identity, e.g. `oaiy-desktop`. Never localised. Match on this.

companion.description: The same identity as `product`, under the name a host app's desktop probe reads.

protocol.description: Protocol the sender speaks. Receivers reject unknown majors rather than guessing.

version.description: Build version. INFORMATIONAL — never gate behaviour on it; it moves for reasons unrelated to the wire format.

apiVersion.description: Version of this HTTP API, so a consumer can refuse a runtime too old for it instead of failing later on a missing route.

pluginApiVersion.description: The newest plugin API this runtime runs.

access.description: How this runtime authorises requests. Sent only when the access guard is in front of the route. Anything but `scoped` is worth a banner.

storage.description: Room on the disk of the credential store. Sent only when the access guard is in front of the route.

runtime.description: Where execution happens. A capability is offered by a runtime, not by the platform in the abstract.

deviceId.description: Stable per-install id, used to pair this device with a cloud tenant.

detail.description: Required when status is `degraded`: what is wrong.
